items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Q2 2026 Earnings Call on Aug 6, 2026 - Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand growth continues to outstrip supply growth. As a result, we exited the second quarter near record lows in terms of days of lithium salt inventory.
